entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The instant application for regular bail has been filed by the petitioner registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 506 and 509 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is a case of establishing physical relationship by the petitioner with the victim/informant and has also clicked several objectionable photos.
It is further alleged that victim's marriage was fixed with Shatrudhan Kumar and the petitioner has sent her objectionable photos with a view to cancel her marriage.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Victim/informant is major lady and she was in consensual physical relationship.

Petitioner has got no criminal Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.59480 of 2023(3)
dt.18-10-2023 antecedent and languishing in judicial custody since 17.4.2023.
Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate -IV, Muzaffarpur in connection with Saraiya (Jaitpur O.P.)
